facilities.name: Brookings Public Library
facilities.description: The city's public library, located one block east of downtown and adjacent to the Children's Museum of South Dakota. Offers books, DVDs, audiobooks, board games, video games, maker kits, and a full calendar of community programs. Open roughly 66 hours a week.

facilities.name: Brookings City Hall (City & County Government Center)
facilities.description: Houses the City Clerk's Office, City Manager's Office, Community Development, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Parks & Recreation departments. Shares the building with Brookings County offices; City Council and County Commission meetings are held in the third-floor chambers.

facilities.name: Dakota Nature Park
facilities.address: 22nd Ave S and 32nd St S, Brookings, SD 57006
facilities.description: A 135-acre park on a former landfill site, restored into trails, ponds, and wildlife habitat. Open for fishing, canoeing/kayaking, hiking, biking, bird-watching, and — in winter — snowshoeing and cross-country skiing. Includes the Larson Nature Center, run by the Brookings Parks, Recreation & Forestry Department.
